card.desc: A window, a bottle, a case - violence with no body in it.
card.prompt: a large pane of window glass shattering once, a sharp initial crack followed by many shards falling and skittering onto a hard floor, close microphone, dry
card.note: The falling debris is what sells it, not the crack. If a seed stops at the crack, discard it - a break with no aftermath sounds like a sample, not an event. Trim the head so the crack lands on your frame, then let the shards run past the cut into the next shot.

evidence.method: nothing has checked this card against pixels
